battle.name: 英國入侵拉普拉塔河
battle.theater: 拉普拉塔河口布宜諾斯艾利斯
battle.brief: 一八〇六年六月，英國遠征軍自好望角出發，六月二十一日在聖伊西德羅登陸，二十七日以艦炮攻破布宜諾斯艾利斯外圍，奪取國庫與劇院；九月二日至十四日，貝爾高德率民兵與常備軍反攻，逐退英軍，恢復首府，史稱「布宜諾斯艾利斯收復戰」。卡面這支一五二〇年的火繩槍，正是民兵手中殘存的舊式火器。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries:
交戰方是英國與西班牙拉普拉塔河總督區。英方由皇家海軍與皇家陸軍組成遠征體系：海軍分隊由副海軍上將約翰·沃特·貝雷斯福德爵士指揮，旗艦是七十四門砲的「多內加爾號」，另有數艘巡洋艦與三級戰列艦在河口與蒙得維的亞外海巡弋；登陸部隊由陸軍上校約翰·貝爾德率領，主體是駐紮在好望角基地的英王第六十步槍團、皇家海軍陸戰隊分隊與皇家砲兵，軍官與士兵多數有在錫蘭與好望角遠征的經驗。英方還握有開普殖民地與圭亞那的德梅拉拉、埃塞奎博等據點，可以把船隊補給與傷兵後送拉得很長。

西方的守軍系統則是拉普拉塔河總督區本身：總督府在布宜諾斯艾利斯，總督加夫列爾·阿維萊斯在英軍逼近時下令棄城，被解職召回西班牙，聖地亞哥·德·利涅爾斯接任；城防主力是「邊防射擊兵」與數百名西班牙本土常備兵，其餘靠克里奧爾城市民兵——七個步兵連與同年九月才成立的「公民志願團」。民兵裝備五花八門，獵槍、長矛與舊式火繩槍居多，訓練與指揮都不成體系。蒙得維的亞由總督方直接控制，是西軍在河口唯一的海軍基地與後方。
countriesEn:
On one side stood Britain, on the other the Viceroyalty of the Rio de la Plata of Spain. The British expedition was a combined Royal Navy and Royal Army enterprise. The naval squadron was commanded by Vice-Admiral Sir John Walter Beresford, whose flagship was the 74-gun Donegal, with several cruisers and third-rate ships of the line patrolling the river mouth and the sea off Montevideo. The landing force was led by Colonel John Baird and consisted mainly of the 60th Regiment of Foot stationed at the Cape base, detachments of Royal Marines and the Royal Artillery; officers and men alike were largely veterans of the Ceylon and Cape campaigns. The British also held the Cape Colony and the Guiana posts of Demerara and Essequibo, which let them stretch their supply line and the withdrawal of the sick a long way behind the fighting.

The Spanish side was the viceregal government itself, seated at Buenos Aires. The viceroy Gabriel de Aviles ordered the city abandoned as the British advanced, was dismissed and recalled to Spain, and was succeeded by Santiago de Liniers. The garrison consisted of the Tiradores de la Frontera and some hundreds of soldiers from metropolitan Spain, with the rest of the defence left to the creole urban militia: seven companies of fusileros and, later that year, the Voluntarios de Patricios. Their arms were a mixture of hunting guns, lances and old matchlocks, and neither their training nor their command was a coherent system. Montevideo, under its own governor, was the only Spanish base and rear area in the estuary.
people:
關鍵人物分在兩條線上。英方最關鍵的是兩人：貝雷斯福德掌握制海權，決定登陸時機與火力準備；貝爾德帶領第六十步槍團與皇家海軍陸戰隊，負責從聖伊西德羅向北的強行軍與攻城，他此前剛在印度與毛里求斯打過仗。英軍入城後，把守備交給英王第六十步槍團的一支分隊，並以艦隊控制河口，斷絕城市與內陸及蒙得維的亞的聯繫。

西線的關鍵人物幾乎全是克里奧爾人。曼努埃爾·貝爾格拉諾是民兵突擊兵連與後來安第斯遠征軍的核心人物，一八〇六年率民兵在城南一線對英軍作戰失利，隨後整編隊伍參與收復戰；胡安·馬丁·德·普耶多洪率「祖國騎士」騎兵切斷英軍通往蒙得維的亞的道路，是逼英軍撤退的關鍵一擊；法國人多米尼哥·弗蘭什主持野戰砲隊，以少量火炮壓制英軍陣地；聖地亞哥·德·利涅爾斯於八月抵任後整頓軍民，以總督身分接管防務；尼克拉斯·德·比亞蒙特以副官身分居中協調；科爾內利奧·薩阿維德拉主持的「公民志願團」則是九月新成立的一支民兵。
peopleEn:
The key figures fall into two lines. On the British side two men mattered most: Beresford, who held the sea power and decided the timing of the landing and the naval preparation, and Baird, who led the 60th Foot and the Royal Marines in the forced march north from San Isidro and in the assault, and who had fought in India and at Mauritius only shortly before. Once the city was taken, the British left a detachment of the 60th Foot as garrison and used their squadron to hold the river, cutting the city off from the interior and from Montevideo.

The figures on the Spanish side were almost entirely creole. Manuel Belgrano, the core of the militia grenadiers and later of the Army of the Andes, fought the British unsuccessfully in the lines south of the city and then reorganized his men to take part in the reconquest; Juan Martin de Pueyrredon and his Husares de la Patria cut the road to Montevideo, the blow that forced the British to withdraw; the Frenchman Domingo French directed the field artillery and used his few guns to pin the British positions; Santiago de Liniers, who arrived in August, reorganized soldiers and civilians alike and took charge of the defence as viceroy; Nicolas de Viamonte coordinated the effort from the adjutant's office; and the Voluntarios de Patricios organized by Cornelio Saavedra were a militia newly raised in September.
kits:
卡面這支一五二〇年的西班牙火繩槍，到一八〇六年已經是三代的舊械。西班牙軍隊在一七世紀末把火繩槍換成燧發滑膛步槍，英國陸軍在一七六〇年代之後也全部改用「棕貝斯」燧發滑膛槍配刺刀。真正還握著火繩槍的，是沒有財力更換裝備的城市民兵連與邊防射擊兵：他們的火器是獵槍、長矛加上一批西班牙殖民時期留下的舊式火繩槍，火繩受潮即失效，因此在潮濕多雨的夏季，槍手常要臨場改用火柴桿或獵槍應急。

英軍的火力編制則是另一套東西：皇家砲兵帶著六磅與九磅野砲及榴彈砲，護衛艦隊的七十四門主力戰列艦與數艘巡洋艦在河口橫掃火力；英軍後來再攻蒙得維的亞時，還用上康格里夫火箭。西軍的火砲主力是「皇家野砲兵」的數門四磅、六磅與八磅砲，配置在城北高地與「舊篷車道」一線的土木工事中。攻城與反攻的關鍵物資除了火藥，還有隨軍輜重車隊、飲水與糧食：英軍在城外紮營的位置在城北棚屋區與舊篷車道之間，正好卡住城市的取水地與通往蒙得維的亞的大道，後勤位置本身就是戰略位置。
kitsEn:
The Spanish matchlock musket of 1520 on the card face was by 1806 a weapon three generations out of date. The Spanish army had replaced the matchlock with the flintlock smoothbore musket by the end of the seventeenth century, and the British army had gone over to the Brown Bess flintlock musket with bayonets after the 1760s. Those still holding matchlocks were the urban militia companies and the border skirmishers, who could not afford to re-equip: their arms were hunting guns, lances and a stock of old matchlocks left over from the colonial period, and because a damp match cord was useless, gunners in the wet southern summer often had to fall back on a matchstick or a hunting gun on the spot.

The British system of fire was a different matter entirely. The Royal Artillery brought six- and nine-pounder field guns and howitzers, and the seventy-four gun line ship and the cruisers of the squadron swept the river mouth with their batteries; when the British came back against Montevideo they also brought Congreve rockets. The Spanish artillery strength was the handful of four-, six- and eight-pounders of the Royal Field Artillery, posted in the earthworks on the heights to the north of the city and along the old cart road. Besides powder, the decisive stores in the siege and in the counterattack were the baggage train, drinking water and grain: the British camp lay between the shanty quarter to the north of the city and the old cart road, which is exactly where the water intake and the road to Montevideo were, so the logistics of the siege were themselves a tactical position.
tactics:
英軍的戰術是一場典型的兩棲強攻加正面突破。六月二十一日在聖伊西德羅登陸後，縱隊沿通往首都的大道推進，前鋒與「祖國騎士」騎兵在城郊接觸；六月二十六日，戰列艦在河口用炮火與縱火驅散城北的守軍，英軍隨即攻下城北唯一像樣的堡壘——那座因為一七七〇年代拆城牆而孤立的「城防砲台」，二十七日入城。

英軍隨後沿河岸在城東南的棚屋區與「舊篷車道」之間紮營挖壘，控制河口、控住取水地，也切斷城市通往蒙得維的亞的陸路，企圖以封鎖逼市府屈服。九月二日，防守方先以步兵連與公民志願團正面強攻，隊形散亂、火力不足，被英軍反衝擊退回；九月五日至六日，西軍把野砲隊與騎兵配在一起，用砲火壓制英軍陣地，再以「祖國騎士」的騎兵衝鋒奪取棚屋區與高地，把英軍擠回舊篷車道一線的土木工事。英軍在得知通往蒙得維的亞的道路已被切斷、又無援兵可待之後，於九月九日夜間登艦撤退，留下殘部與工事在九月十四日被西軍接收。火繩槍兵在這些交火裡多編在民兵第一線與街壘，裝填慢使他們難以與英軍的燧發步槍對射，只能在近身與夜間發揮。
tacticsEn:
The British battle was a textbook amphibious assault and frontal breakthrough. After landing at San Isidro on 21 June, the columns advanced along the road to the capital, the vanguard making contact with the Husares de la Patria cavalry on the outskirts of town; on 26 June the ships of the line used their guns and incendiaries from the river to drive the defenders off the heights north of the city, and the British then took the only real fortification there, the city battery that had been left isolated when the walls were demolished in the 1770s, and entered the city on the 27th.

The British then entrenched along the river between the shanty quarter to the south-east of the city and the old cart road, holding the estuary, holding the water intake and cutting the land road to Montevideo, in the hope of bringing the city to terms by blockade. On 2 September the defenders attacked head on with the fusilier companies and the Patricios, but the formation was loose and the fire was thin, and they were driven back by a British counter-charge. On 5 and 6 September the defenders paired the field guns with the cavalry: the guns pinned the British positions, the Husares de la Patria charged and took the shanty ground and the heights, and the British were squeezed back into the earthworks along the old cart road. Learning that the road to Montevideo had been cut and that no relief could come, the British boarded their ships and withdrew during the night of 9 September; the remaining detachment and the works were taken over by the Spanish on 14 September. In all of this the matchlock men sat in the first line of the militia and on the barricades, and their slow loading meant they could never trade volleys with the British flintlock muskets, so they could only act at close range and at night.
data:
可核對的數字大致如下。一八〇六年六月的英軍遠征兵力，各家記載在一千五百至二千人之間，砲約十餘門，護衛分隊包括數艘戰列艦與巡洋艦，另有十餘艘運輸船；登陸在六月二十一日，城市在二十七日陷落，前後只用了六天。守軍方面，六月二十六日城北可用的西班牙本土常備兵只有數百人，加上七個城市步兵連的民兵，砲約二十門。當年布宜諾斯艾利斯城的人口約四萬至五萬人。

收復戰的兵力各家統計出入頗大：民兵與常備軍合計約一千四百至二千人，攜帶野砲數門到十餘門不等；英軍留在城東南的守備兵力遠少於遠征總數，具體數目各書不一，約數百人。九月二日第一次強攻失利，防守方損失數十人；九月五日至六日的主要交火中，英軍傷亡為數十人，數字各書不一，收復戰全程英軍被俘者不過數十人。英軍在城內掠奪的銀器、教會器物與公私財物，數目眾說紛紜。一八〇七年一月英軍再攻蒙得維的亞，守軍約二千至三千人，經過二十餘日砲擊後該城於二月四日陷落，英軍隨後退出拉普拉塔河。
dataEn:
The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The strength of the British expedition in June 1806 is given by different sources as between fifteen hundred and two thousand men, with a dozen or so cannon; the escorting squadron counted several ships of the line and cruisers, with a dozen or more transports; the landing was made on 21 June and the city fell on the 27th, so the whole business took six days. On the defensive side, the number of soldiers from metropolitan Spain available north of the city on 26 June was only a few hundred, joined by the militia of the seven urban fusilier companies, with about twenty guns. The population of Buenos Aires at the time was on the order of forty to fifty thousand.

Estimates of the forces in the reconquest differ a good deal: the militia and the regulars together are put at somewhere between fourteen hundred and two thousand men, carrying from a few field guns to a dozen or more, while the British garrison left in the south-east of the city was far below the total of the expedition, its exact size recorded variously at a few hundred. The first assault of 2 September failed and cost the defenders a few dozen men; in the main fighting of 5 and 6 September British casualties are again given as a few dozen, the accounts disagreeing, and only a few dozen British were taken prisoner over the whole business. The silver, church plate and private property the British carried off from the city cannot be reckoned: the accounts are all over the place. The British returned against Montevideo in January 1807; the garrison was some two to three thousand men, and after more than twenty days of bombardment the city fell on 4 February, after which the British withdrew from the Rio de la Plata.
cause:
遠因是拿破崙戰爭。西班牙自一七九六年起與法國結盟，一八〇五年拿破崙在奧斯特里茨擊潰第三次反法同盟，歐洲大陸再無能制衡法國的力量，於是英國把切斷西班牙美洲的銀源、把殖民地換上英國旗，當成打擊拿破崙的辦法之一。西班牙的白銀船隊自一七九九年起屢遭英國分遣艦攔截，白銀運不回歐洲去支持戰爭，這是英國遠征的商務與戰略背景。

近因是英國在好望角得手。一八〇五年八月英軍在布萊斯堡登陸，奪取荷屬開普殖民地，取得一處可以屯兵、修船、轉運的基地；隨後計畫沿南大西洋向西班牙美洲殖民地推進，拉普拉塔河因為停泊著西班牙的銀船隊而排在最前。葡萄牙攝政政府雖未公開參戰，一度默許英國船隊取道巴西口岸，這層默契在英軍攻下布宜諾斯艾利斯、葡方擔憂西班牙報復之後便告中止。

而布宜諾斯艾利斯方面的隱患，是西班牙本土守軍稀少、城市沒有城牆、克里奧爾民兵被歧視又無像樣的裝備，這套結構本身在英軍的推進面前毫無抵抗力。
causeEn:
The remote cause was the Napoleonic war. Spain had been allied with France since 1796, and in 1805 Napoleon had destroyed the Third Coalition at Austerlitz, leaving no power on the continent able to hold France in check; the British therefore resolved to cut off the silver of Spanish America and to change the flag over the colonies, treating it as one of the ways of hitting Napoleon. Spanish silver fleets had been intercepted by British cruisers again and again from 1799 onward, and the bullion could no longer be carried back to Europe to pay for the war; that was the commercial and strategic setting of the expedition.

The proximate cause was British success at the Cape. In August 1805 the British landed at Blaauwberg, took the Dutch Cape Colony and gained a base where troops could be concentrated, ships repaired and cargo transshipped; the plan that followed was to advance along the South Atlantic against the Spanish colonies of America, and the Rio de la Plata came first because the Spanish silver fleets lay there. The Portuguese regency did not join in openly, but for a time it allowed British ships to use Brazilian ports; that understanding lapsed once the British had taken Buenos Aires and Lisbon's Rio de Janeiro began to fear Spanish reprisals.

The weakness on the Buenos Aires side was structural: too few soldiers from Spain, no city walls, a creole militia that was kept in suspicion and badly equipped. That structure offered no real resistance to a British advance.
impact:
第一層影響在殖民地的政治心理。布宜諾斯艾利斯守住自己的首都、逼走英軍，這是南美洲克里奧爾人第一次靠本地武裝把歐洲常備軍趕出城門，後來被反覆引用為「我們能守住」的證據。一八〇六年九月成立的「公民志願團」，由科爾內利奧·薩阿維德拉主持，是西屬美洲最早有明確章程的城市民兵；一八一〇年五月革命時布宜諾斯艾利斯民兵成為主力，其制度源頭正落在這一年。

第二層影響在軍事制度上。收復戰暴露了西班牙常備軍的稀少與民兵裝備的落後，一八〇六至一八〇七年間總督區被迫整編「邊防軍」，把民兵與正規軍混編，克里奧爾軍官第一次大批進入軍隊，這是後來「拉普拉塔河方面軍」的雛形；同時也埋下常備軍與民兵互相猜疑、爭奪指揮權的種子，這種矛盾在一八一〇年五月之後全面爆發。

第三層影響在國際格局。英軍在拉普拉塔河的征伐最終只換來一場羞辱：布宜諾斯艾利斯沒拿下一座，卻在一年後攻下西班牙的蒙得維的亞，迫使西班牙把殖民地防務的注意力完全轉向英國；英國自此把重心移回歐洲，一八〇九年克拉福德突襲蒙得維的亞港失敗之後，英國在拉普拉塔河的軍事存在基本退場。
impactEn:
The first layer of impact lay in the political mood of the colonies. Buenos Aires had held its own capital and driven out a European regular army by means of local troops alone, the first time creoles in South America had done so, and it was afterwards quoted over and over as proof that they could defend themselves. The Voluntarios de Patricios, founded in September 1806 under Cornelio Saavedra, were among the earliest urban militias in Spanish America with written ordinances; when the May Revolution of 1810 came, the Buenos Aires militia was the main armed strength in the city, and the institutional thread leads straight back to that year.

The second layer was institutional and military. The reconquest laid bare how thin the Spanish regular army was and how poor the militia equipment, and between 1806 and 1807 the viceroyalty was driven to reorganize an Army of the Frontier that mixed militia and regulars, with creole officers entering the army in numbers for the first time; this was the embryo of what would later be the Army of the Rio de la Plata. At the same time it sowed the seed of the mutual suspicion between regulars and militia over the right to give orders, a contradiction that broke out in full after May 1810.

The third layer was geopolitical. The British campaign in the Rio de la Plata brought them little but humiliation: they did not hold Buenos Aires, yet a year later they took Montevideo, which forced Spain to turn its entire attention in the colonies towards Britain. Britain shifted its weight back to Europe, and after Craufurd's unsuccessful raid on Montevideo in 1809 the British military presence in the Rio de la Plata had all but disappeared.
result:
直接結果是英國在拉普拉塔河上游的第一次大規模進攻失敗。一八〇六年九月十四日，英軍最後的殘部與工事被西軍接收，貝雷斯福德率艦隊退出河口，轉往蒙得維的亞；布宜諾斯艾利斯設宴慶祝，克里奧爾民兵第一次被當作保衛首府的武力看待。英國的目標沒有達成：布宜諾斯艾利斯沒有拿下一座，拉普拉塔河的白銀船隊仍然照常入港，西班牙美洲的旗幟沒有被換掉。

但戰役並未就此結束。英軍把矛頭轉向蒙得維的亞，一八〇七年一月二十八日起砲擊該城，二月四日守軍投降，伊西德羅省總督弗朗西斯科·哈維耶爾·德·埃利奧被解職。英國在拉普拉塔河唯一的收穫是一座西班牙港口，而不是一片殖民地。

從更長的視角看，這場戰爭的另一個結局是英國在西班牙美洲的整體計畫被擱置。英軍雖然在蒙得維的亞得手，卻沒有足夠兵力佔領廣袤的拉普拉塔河省，遠征軍在一八〇七年秋離開南美洲，注意力回到歐洲。對西班牙而言，這是一場更大的羞辱：它在歐洲正被拿破崙步步逼近的同時，居然在本土以外被英國奪去一座重要港口，殖民地軍制的弱點從此被徹底暴露。
resultEn:
The immediate result was the failure of Britain's first large-scale attempt in the upper Rio de la Plata. On 14 September 1806 the last British detachment and the works were taken over by the Spanish, Beresford took his squadron out of the estuary and stood down towards Montevideo, and Buenos Aires gave a banquet of thanksgiving: the creole militia was for the first time treated as the armed force that had saved the capital. The British aim had not been achieved. They held no part of Buenos Aires, the silver fleets still entered the river as before, and the Spanish flag still flew over Spanish America.

The campaign was not over, however. The British turned their guns on Montevideo; from 28 January 1807 the city was bombarded, the garrison surrendered on 4 February, and the governor of the Banda Oriental, Francisco Javier de Elio, was dismissed. The one thing Britain won in the Rio de la Plata was a Spanish port, not a colony.

Seen over the longer run, the other outcome of this war was the shelving of the British plan for Spanish America. Although the British had succeeded at Montevideo, they lacked the troops to occupy the vast province of the Rio de la Plata, and the expedition left South America in the autumn of 1807 with its attention back on Europe. For Spain it was a deeper humiliation: while Napoleon was closing in on the peninsula, the mother country had lost an important port beyond its own shores, and the weakness of the colonial military system was laid bare.
